items.detail: Check nests outside Abandoned Waste Dump in The Mire

items.detail: Join at Rapidan Camp on the hour, light the pyre and complete all acts

items.title: Craft a Grenade, Mine, or Thrown Weapon
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench or Weapons Workbench

items.detail: Level 2 terminal at Watoga Transit Hub or level 0 at Fort Atlas

items.title: Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
items.detail: Kill Lost Dwellers during the Mischief Night public event

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Shotgun
items.detail: Eastern Regional Penitentiary has close-range combat favoring shotguns

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies with energy weapons

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if one is placed

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: Use laser rifles, plasma guns, Tesla rifles, or gauss weapons at RobCo Research Center

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Collect from wild plants or farms like Silva Homestead

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as an uninvited guest at Head Hunt events during Slasher season's final stage

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find Pumpkin Pie at Pumpkin House kitchen or buy from Whitespring vendors

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any NPC vendor such as those at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to a player's C.A.M.P. with a shelter and enter it
